pose_noise.coordinate: camera-center world translation and right camera rotation; shared across features per frame
pose_noise.model: stationary Gaussian OU plus independent jitter
pose_noise.recursion: a=exp(-dt/0.5); n_k=a*n_(k-1)+sqrt(1-a*a)*sigma*z_k; n_0=sigma*z_0; add independent jitter
pose_noise.covariance: Cov(n_i,n_j)=sigma^2 exp(-abs(t_i-t_j)/0.5) I + delta_ij jitter^2 I; map camera pose error through nonzero lever arm; same execution pose index reused

stereo_if_used.extrinsics: fixed known synthetic; real fixed calibration, approximation disclosed

confirmation_policy: one frozen method; no outcome-based retuning after confirmation begins
conditional_candidates: at most three more, evidence and identity registered before results

geometry_MC.sampling: time/parallax strata fixed before truth error labels
geometry_MC.resampling: time blocks, never independent feature pose noise

numerical_tests.bypass: exact full state/P/FEJ/visual ID and trajectory digest equality
numerical_tests.cache: exact deterministic input/seed/state/event equality; no silent tolerance relaxation

uncertainty_claim: uncalibrated local directional risk until evidence supports probability intervals
GT: offline evaluator only; no selector/cache GT
